cases.proposition: The onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender to equal owner before reaching the function-body placeholder.
cases.boundary: Modifier condition only; does not establish the ownership lifecycle or authorization of unrelated entry points.

cases.proposition: The executeLiquidation function calls pool.flashLoanSimple with address(this) as receiver, debtAsset as the borrowed asset and debtToCover as the requested amount.
cases.boundary: Call arguments only; does not establish that the configured pool is valid or that the transaction succeeds.

cases.proposition: The withdrawETH function sends address(this).balance to owner using payable(owner).transfer.
cases.boundary: Transfer statement only; does not establish all withdrawal authorization or native-asset accounting safety.

cases.proposition: The constructor reverts when the supplied _aavePool address equals address(0).
cases.boundary: One constructor guard only; does not establish the validity or behavior of a nonzero pool address.

cases.proposition: The per-call floor is assigned the larger of minProfitForCall and the stored minProfit value using a conditional expression.
cases.boundary: Floor-selection expression only; does not establish that the floor covers gas, MEV, slippage or realized net profitability.

cases.proposition: _resolveSwapPath checks the direct token pair fee tier first and returns a packed direct path when that fee tier is nonzero.
cases.boundary: Direct-path branch only; does not establish the behavior or success of intermediate routes or actual swap execution.
